name: Byclaw Wiki
description: Keep configured GitHub repositories indexed with CodeGraph and expose code_to_wiki for source-aware answers.

repositories.description: Git repositories to mirror and index. Defaults to beyonai/ByClaw develop.

id.description: Stable repository id used by code_to_wiki.

branch.description: Branch to clone, pull, and index.

localPath.description: Optional managed checkout path. Relative paths resolve under dataDir/repos.

dataDir.description: Plugin data directory. Defaults to OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/byclaw-wiki.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the weekly sync schedule.

syncDayOfWeek.description: Scheduled sync day, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday.

runOnStartup.description: Run a sync when the plugin service starts.

httpPath.description: Gateway HTTP route for status and manual sync.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for git and codegraph commands.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum command output captured per stream.

retryInitialDelayMs.description: Initial retry delay after clone, pull, or index failure.

retryMaxAttempts.description: Maximum automatic retry attempts after a failed sync.

includeRawOutputInToolResult.description: Whether code_to_wiki returns raw CodeGraph output to OpenClaw. Default true lets agents inspect source and generate documents.

gitDepth.description: Git clone/fetch depth. Default 1 keeps only the latest commit for faster sync.

notificationDingtalkAccessToken.description: Optional DingTalk custom robot access token. Used to build the webhook URL when notificationWebhookUrl is not set.

notificationDingtalkSecret.description: Optional DingTalk robot SEC secret used to sign webhook requests.

notificationDingtalkActionCardBtnUrl.description: Optional DingTalk ActionCard button URL. Leave empty to send the card without a jump URL.

notificationDocumentUploadUrl.description: COS upload endpoint for generated operation documents. Relative paths resolve against BYCLAW_WIKI_COS_UPLOAD_BASE_URL or http://localhost:3000.

notificationDocumentUploadPrefix.description: Optional COS object prefix for generated operation documents.

notificationMaxOutputChars.description: Compatibility setting retained for older configs; robot notifications no longer include full document bodies.

notificationMinOutputChars.description: Minimum output characters required before sending a notification.
